1.0: ...Just tell me what you want, and I'll get it for you. An item? Information? Dirt on someone? Just tell me anything, and I'll get it for you. What? A missing alchemist? You mean, #p2111002#...? Hmm... yes. He frequently visited yours truly just before his disappearance. Anyway, what about it? What? You want some information on #p2111002#?
1.1: Fine. The information will cost you #b5,000 Mesos#k. Pay up, and the info's all yours.

yes.0: Tsk tsk... This is definitely an unexpected source of income. This is good! Now, as promised, I'll give you the information on #p2111002#, as long as you're ready to pay me. Come see me when you're ready.

npc.0: You haven't gone to #b#p2111007##k yet? He's a salesperson... one that sells the darkness of evil... so you won't be able to talk to him without money.

0.0: I don't think I can totally trust you... but maybe that's the reason why I can let you work on this. I want you to see #p2111002# in a 3rd person's point of view, unaffiliated with the past of Zenumist and Alcadno, what he wanted, and make a decision on whether it was the right thing to do.

yes.0: Apparently, just before he went missing, #p2111002# had been in close contact with a suspicious character. Have you heard of #r#p2111007##k? ...he's a man with a very questionable reputation. Regardless, I also hear that he is very trustworthy in business deals, so I think he'll be good. You may get some information on #p2111002# through him...
yes.1: Oh, and... know this one thing. #p2111007# loves money. He doesn't even speak to people that don't have a substantial amount of mesos with them, so I highly advise you to prepare some before the meeting.

no.0: Are you too afraid to encounter the truth? If so, then there's nothing I can do... maybe it's a wise thing not to pursue matters on #p2111002# any further.
